decisions.rationale: Lead Whimsicott + Tsareena to establish Tailwind while Queenly Majesty blocks Fake Out, Bullet Punch, and Ice Shard. Tsareena pressures Rotom-Wash and Dark/Steel leads. Politoed enables rain, then Basculegion cleans with rain-boosted Adaptability attacks.
decisions.notebook: Core plan: lead Whimsicott + Tsareena when priority disruption is likely; Queenly Majesty protects Tailwind setup from Fake Out, Bullet Punch, and Ice Shard. Preserve Politoed to establish rain safely, then deploy Basculegion under Tailwind/rain. Tsareena is the primary Rotom-Wash answer. Basculegion is the main Mega Metagross pressure once rain is active. Opponent may bring Aerodactyl for Tailwind/Wide Guard, Incineroar for Intimidate cycling, and Rotom-Wash to check Water offense.

decisions.rationale: Lead Incineroar+Metagross: Fake Out+Meteor Mash removes Whimsicott through sash before Prankster Tailwind/Taunt; Intimidate+Parting Shot pivoting. Incineroar walls Mega Delphox (resists Heat Wave/Shadow Ball/Grass Knot); Metagross resists the rain core's Water moves. Rotom-Wash in back answers Politoed/Basculegion with Thunderbolt and Levitate blanks Mudsdale; Aerodactyl supplies Tailwind (max-speed Mega Delphox 204 edges my 200) plus Wide Guard vs Heat Wave/Icy Wind/Rock Slide.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs actual enemy team (Whimsicott/Basculegion/Delphox-Mega/Politoed/Tsareena/Mudsdale — old notebook's Ampharos/Toxicroak/Metagross were wrong). Brought: Incineroar+Metagross lead, Rotom-W+Aerodactyl back. Key facts: (1) Mega Delphox has Levitate — EQ immune, Fire resists Ice, so Mamoswine/Metagross can't hurt it; Incineroar WALLS it (resists all 3 attacks) — preserve Incineroar. Max-speed Mega Delphox 204 > Aerodactyl 200, so need Tailwind or Fake Out chip + Bullet Punch. (2) Basculegion is Adaptability, not Swift Swim; rain-boosted Wave Crash still hurts; Rotom Thunderbolt answers both Waters; Metagross resists Water but fears Last Respects (Ghost SE) as allies faint. (3) Whimsicott Prankster Taunt/Tailwind has +1 priority, beats Aerodactyl's Taunt/Tailwind; answer = Fake Out + Meteor Mash (sash then KO). (4) Tsareena Queenly Majesty blocks Fake Out/Ice Shard/Bullet Punch vs it and allies; Wide Lens HJK threatens Incineroar, Power Whip threatens Rotom; answer = Flare Blitz/Meteor Mash. (5) Mudsdale Inner Focus ignores Fake Out flinch; High Horsepower SE vs Incineroar/Metagross; answer = Rotom (Levitate, Hydro Pump), Aerodactyl (Flying). (6) Wide Guard blocks Heat Wave/Icy Wind/Rock Slide spreads.

decisions.rationale: Tailwind is guaranteed while Queenly Majesty blocks opposing priority. Protect preserves Tsareena from the likely Flare Blitz or Mega Metagross attack, maintaining the key Rotom-Wash answer and avoiding committing a -1 attack. This creates a safe route to bring in Politoed and Basculegion under Tailwind.

decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs enemy team: Whimsicott/Basculegion/Delphox/Politoed/Tsareena/Mudsdale. Brought: Incineroar+Metagross lead, Rotom-W+Aerodactyl back. Whimsicott always gets 1 move off (sash, no Protect, Prankster +1); Encore fails turn 1. (2) Whimsicott is their ONLY speed control (Tailwind); once dead, Aerodactyl (200) freely Tailwinds/Taunts — only max-speed Mega Delphox (204) outspeeds. (3) Mega Delphox has Levitate; Incineroar walls all 3 attacks (Heat Wave/Shadow Ball/Grass Knot) — preserve Incineroar for it; otherwise kill via chip + Bullet Punch or under Tailwind. (4) Basculegion Adaptability Life Orb: Wave Crash hurts, Last Respects (Ghost) threatens Metagross as allies faint; Rotom Thunderbolt answers it + Politoed. (5) Tsareena Wide Lens implies offensive EVs — Flare Blitz likely OHKOs; its -1 HJK does ~44-75% to Incineroar (Sitrus procs); can't Bullet Punch it (QM). (6) Mudsdale Inner Focus ignores Fake Out; High Horsepower SE vs Incin/Metagross; answer = Rotom (Levitate+Hydro Pump) / Aerodactyl. (7) Wide Guard blocks Heat Wave/Icy Wind/Rock Slide. (8) Tools say Steel = 2x vs Whimsicott — trust tools over memory. (9) Metagross is our only Mega brought — evolve freely, no bluff cost.

decisions.rationale: Double-target Incineroar with rain-boosted Weather Ball and super-effective High Jump Kick. Tailwind guarantees both move before the foes, while Queenly Majesty blocks Fake Out. Lessons: (1) Queenly Majesty blocks ALL opposing priority vs Tsareena AND allies. (2) Whimsicott is their only Tailwind; once gone Aerodactyl (200) controls speed — only max Mega Delphox outspeeds. Tailwind applies the turn used. (3) Basculegion Adaptability Life Orb Jolly: Last Respects = 50+50 per fainted ally (BP150 with 2; tools show BP50 — trust this note) — OHKOs Metagross from 50%, Rotom from FULL; Incineroar (Dark) resists it. Wave Crash OHKOs Incineroar even at -1 Atk WITHOUT rain (~91-156% from 84%) — NEVER leave Incin exposed to Basculegion. Kill only with faster mons or double-target: Rotom (118) is slower than Jolly Basc (143 max) — Thunderbolt 58-106% (Modest 163 SpA) is Tailwind/revenge-only; pair with Flare Blitz chip (resisted, 20-38%) to secure. Fake Out immune (Ghost), Bullet Punch resisted; Metagross Zen Headbutt 37-70% (90% acc — don't sack early). (4) Rain halves Flare Blitz; Politoed rain Weather Ball = 61-139% vs Incineroar (never switch Incin into it), resisted by Rotom — Rotom walls Politoed; Thunderbolt vs Calm Politoed 51.8-90.9% (Sitrus, needs chip). No-rain Politoed harmless: Weather Ball only ~10-20% vs Rotom, can't hurt Incineroar, no recovery.

decisions.rationale: Focus Rotom-Wash, the immediate super-effective threat. Weather Ball is the strongest available single-target damage; Icy Wind is resisted by both foes and cannot overcome their Tailwind advantage in time.
decisions.notebook: Core plan: enable Life Orb Adaptability Basculegion with Drizzle, Tailwind, and Queenly Majesty; preserve it for late-game when possible. Opponent aggressively doubles Whimsicott through Sash. Incineroar uses Intimidate/Protect pivots; Basculegion is immune to Fake Out. Rotom-Wash has no Protect and is naturally slower than 143-Speed Basculegion, but opposing Tailwind reverses that order. Aerodactyl carries Tailwind, Rock Slide, Wide Guard, and Taunt; single-target attacks bypass Wide Guard. With two allies fainted, Last Respects reaches 150 BP before STAB, Adaptability, and Life Orb. Politoed rain Weather Ball dealt 51% to Mega Metagross. Helping Hand's +5 priority acts before Fake Out. Against this composition, preserve Tailwind control or remove Aerodactyl before exposing Basculegion to Rotom-Wash.

decisions.rationale: Politoed is their last mon at 72%, -2 Atk, no rain, and we outspeed with Tailwind (Rotom 236, Incin 160 vs 90-122). Rotom Thunderbolt (51.8-90.9%) + Flare Blitz chip (~20-38%) KOs through Sitrus on most rolls; worst case it survives at ~7-25%, deals negligible no-rain Weather Ball damage, and we finish next turn with Tailwind still up. Recoil is irrelevant since the game ends on the KO. Volt Switch/Parting Shot are pointless with no bench need.

decisions.rationale: Politoed is their last remaining mon at 9%, paralyzed, -2 Atk — it cannot threaten either of my mons. Double-target it to end the game: Rotom (236 Spe) moves first and Thunderbolt (2x SE) certainly KOs; Incineroar's Flare Blitz is backup and takes no recoil if Rotom KOs first. Even a Protect just delays one turn with zero risk.

reflections.summary: Lost because Aerodactyl established Tailwind, allowing Rotom-Wash to outspeed and KO Basculegion; the support-heavy four then lacked a viable secondary endgame despite removing Mega Metagross. Bringing no Mega option also left the plan overly dependent on Basculegion.
reflections.adjustment: Rework preview around keeping Tsareena available to pressure Rotom-Wash and deny Incineroar priority, while prioritizing Aerodactyl before it can set Tailwind. Reassess omitting a Mega Stone holder if a matchup-suitable option is available.
reflections.notebook: Opponent uses Aerodactyl as post-KO speed control and Rotom-Wash as the primary answer to the rain core; under opposing Tailwind, Rotom outspeeds 143-Speed Basculegion and attacks freely without Protect. Incineroar supports that endgame with Intimidate and sustained Flare Blitz pressure. Preserve Tsareena for Rotom-Wash, deny Aerodactyl's Tailwind, and avoid a preview plan whose only durable damage route is Basculegion.

reflections.summary: Won with zero decision errors: killing Whimsicott (their only speed control) early let Aerodactyl's Tailwind lock speed, and the Rotom-Wash + Incineroar endgame hard-walled the rain core — Intimidate neutered Basculegion, Rotom resisted Aqua Jet/Weather Ball, and Thunderbolt plus Flare Blitz chip cleaned up. The only setback, Mega Metagross lost to a Zen Headbutt miss into Last Respects, was matchup + luck, not piloting. The four brought and the Metagrossite pick suited this opponent's actual br
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same four and Mega Metagross, but reposition Metagross as a Whimsicott-only answer — never leave it in vs Basculegion (Last Respects) or Tsareena (HJK); pivot Incineroar into Last Respects instead. When Basculegion is likely to Protect (it did vs our double-target), aim at the partner that turn rather than wasting Thunderbolt.
